label: Black Scarab estimated compensation
basis: advertised annual salary, excluding bonus and equity
method: Median of one annual salary-range midpoint per distinct eligible requisition.
eligibility: U.S. factory/robotic-cell automation roles owning PLC/control systems, with reviewed duties and complete explicitly annual USD ranges.
limitations: Only two eligible annual observations: an experienced OSARO role and senior Skydio role, both in California. A narrow editorial estimate, not an entry-level rate or representative market median. Structured salary fields do not consistently identify base pay. Other reviewed employers publish amounts without a verifiable annual period; no annual conversion assumed.

observations.title: Controls Engineer, PLC Programming
observations.scope: PLC and HMI programming for AI robotic material-handling cells; integration and commissioning.

observations.title: Senior Automation Controls Engineer
observations.sourceClause: Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $145,000 - $219,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.
observations.scope: Drone manufacturing equipment: PLCs, HMI/SCADA, robotic assembly, production troubleshooting and data collection. Original primary classifier assigned robot controls; contextual review assigns factory automation for this guide.
